title: Own daily dependency updater and triage current batch
description:
Take over coordination of the personal-site daily dependency updater, as explicitly requested by Benjamin. Acknowledge ownership by marking this task in_progress and appending an initial status. You own triage, dispatch, monitoring and reporting from here.

Approved scope: daily 09:00 America/New_York scan of all eligible dependencies; one existing persistent bead and one atomic commit per package (affected manifests plus root bun.lock); direct normal pushes to main without PRs; cheap parallel preparation; one publisher serializes landing. No local production builds. Keep normal relevant verification. Hold major, prerelease, potentially breaking, source-pinned/coupled or failed checks for review. Do not weaken checks, fix unrelated app code, force-push, or duplicate batches/beads.

City /Users/benjaminschachter/personal-site-city; rig personal-site; repository /Users/benjaminschachter/personal-site. Existing pack gascity/dependency-updates. Existing order update-one invokes scan-updates. User additionally asked for five more workers: pool cap is now eight gpt-6-luna low preparers, live status enumerates worker-1 through worker-8. Keep singleton publisher. Latest snapshot: seven closed, 22 blocked, no runnable dependency work; adding capacity alone does not start blocked jobs. Review each hold and requeue the SAME bead only when its actual blocker is resolved. Use isolated clones; do not alter shared checkout/runtime files or push unrelated local commits.

Establish a supported wake/wait mechanism for oversight and document its proof boundary (bead-close wait alone does not wake on blocked transitions). Do not assume an idle active mayor session continuously monitors. Report accepted ownership, eligible retries dispatched, actual running count, held reasons and confirmed landed SHAs. If all remaining holds require user decisions, leave them blocked and report them rather than retrying blindly.
